steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Use the hostname you set as SearXNG's base_url; a mismatch breaks the redirect after saving preferences.

steps.title: Security - Client address
steps.subtitle: Send SearXNG only the real client address in X-Forwarded-For so its limiter cannot be dodged with a forged one.

steps.title: HTTP - Preferences
steps.subtitle: A preferences save sets 22 cookies in one response; larger buffers keep a save with many engines toggled from ending in a 502.

steps.title: Request rate
steps.subtitle: An image results page sends 37 requests in its first second; raise this when many people share one address.

steps.title: Security - External bangs
steps.subtitle: Drops form-action 'self' so a !!g style bang can redirect to another site; keep the default CSP if you disable external bangs.

steps.title: Security - Review search text CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Let searches for SQL, shell, markup and path strings through the search and autocomplete query; the same text anywhere else stays blocked.
